sections.title: music for theater/ dance/ performance

items.title: Engel der Vernichtung
items.text:
The music for Engel der Vernichtung functions more like a film score than a traditional theatre soundtrack. Throughout the piece, sound is continuously present, whether through atmospheres, textures, or recurring musical motifs.

To meet the demands of a live cinema piece, where rapid cuts between scenes require equally precise shifts in the music, I developed a technological environment that allows for highly controlled transitions, cuts, and musical changes in real time, with live synchronisation between sound, video, and light.

items.title: HARD_BREAK
items.text: To place the pieces topic at the core of the soundtrack, I drew inspiration from heartbreak songs of the 2000s. I sampled hooks, reworked chord progressions, and distilled their moods and emotional textures. I then contrasted this material with the raw aesthetics of heavy bass and rave music, creating a soundtrack that leaves room for tears, anger, hope, and release.

items.title: GOTT
items.text: GOTT is a rather text-heavy, dry, and formal piece. I tried to create music that makes the piece more accessible and engaging, while also bringing out an eerie dimension.

sections.text: Since 2022, I have composed the soundtracks for more than ten theatre productions. Visit my website to discover the full list and explore all my work.

sections.title: freelancing

items.title: Sprachenland
items.role: sound spatialization for tracked headphone system
items.text: The exhibition Sprachenland at the Landesmuseum Zürich featured a head-tracking system developed by iart, which calculates a real-time binaural 3D mix for each visitor. As a freelancer, I spatialized all the music within a digital twin of the museum.

items.title: Audiobreeze
items.text: For the company Audiobreeze, I programmed a prototype of their immersive 3D audio system, which creates evolving spatial soundscapes from multichannel nature recordings. My work focused on developing and exploring the technical possibilities of the prototype.

sections.text: As a freelancer, I take on projects ranging from sound design and music production to programming and interactive media.

items.title: Terminal Infinity
items.text: For Alexander Schubert’s multimedia production *Terminal Infinity*, I designed the video using the 3D software Blender.

items.title: KNÄULED
items.text: Together with the light collective Göral, we created the audiovisual installation *Knäuled* at Neubad in Lucerne. The installation, consisting of 1 km of LED strips, featured a one-hour soundtrack synchronized with the lighting design, with both sound and light influenced by live sensor data.

items.title: Asterism
items.text: For the 72-hour performance *Asterism* at the Maillon Festival in Strasbourg, I spatialized the soundtrack composed by Alexander Schubert to a multichannel setup.

items.title: candid
items.text: Under my first name, I release tracks influenced by a variety of bass-heavy genres, as well as ambient music. This is where I experiment with new ways of shaping and processing sound, exploring different approaches to texture, rhythm, and sonic space.

items.title: prix garanti
items.text: Since 2021, I have been the producer and bassist of the band Prix Garanti.

items.title: a kind machine
items.text:
A KIND MACHINE was the result of a two-month residency at Lichthoftheater Hamburg. I explored a theatrical language without a human body present on stage. Through robots, everyday devices, and conventional stage elements, I investigated the technological reality we live in.

items.title: the meadow
items.text:
The Meadow is a music theatre piece that engages with the eerie qualities of the self-help tools we integrate into our everyday lives.

A singer called Alice tries to escape the pressure of her work by turning to a mysterious application called 'the meadow'. She finds herself lying in the green grass, watching fluffy clouds drift by, when suddenly new doors open, and her journey turns into a feverish dream
